# Tamworth Skip Bins

> Skip bins in Tamworth, Calala, Kootingal, Manilla and surrounds. See published local price ranges and get a free quote from one local skip bin operator.

Tamworth Skip Bins (tamworthskipbins.com) is a free skip bin quote and referral service, not a skip hire company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, skip size, waste type, then contact details) and the request goes to one local skip bin operator, who quotes, supplies the skip and sets the price and hire terms.

- Service: skip bin hire quotes
- Area: Tamworth, Tamworth Regional Council (NSW), including East Tamworth, West Tamworth, North Tamworth, South Tamworth, Hillvue, Westdale, Oxley Vale, Calala, Taminda, Nemingha, Kootingal, Moonbi, Hallsville, Moore Creek, Woolomin, Bendemeer, Attunga, Manilla, Barraba, Duri
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: see "Quick answers" on the homepage for published ranges and their dates; otherwise a local operator quotes

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Tamworth Skip Bins cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take skip bin quote requests from Tamworth and nearby areas, including East Tamworth, West Tamworth, North Tamworth, South Tamworth, Hillvue, Westdale, Oxley Vale, Calala, Taminda, Nemingha, Kootingal, Moonbi, Hallsville, Moore Creek, Woolomin, Bendemeer, Attunga, Manilla, Barraba, Duri. The quote service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. The operator includes delivery and pick-up in its quote. Longer hire periods, deliveries out to Barraba, Manilla or Bendemeer, and tricky access can change the price.
- **Do I need a licence or permit for a skip bin?** You don't need a licence to hire a skip. A skip wholly on your own property generally doesn't need approval. On a road, footpath or nature strip, Tamworth Regional Council requires an "Approval to Place Waste in a Public Place" under section 68, listed at $120 in its 2025–26 fees. Call council on (02) 6767 5555. Asbestos is different: asbestos can't go in a general skip. More than 10 m² of bonded asbestos must be removed by a licensed removalist in NSW.
- **What affects the price of a skip bin?** One operator servicing Tamworth published $250–$400 for a 3-day hire and $280–$430 for a 7-day hire across its bin sizes (checked 23 Oct 2026). These aren't our prices or a quote. Size, waste type, weight, hire length and delivery distance all change the price, and a local operator will quote for your job.
- **Who supplies the skip?** Tamworth Skip Bins is a free referral and quote service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't own skips or trucks. We pass your request to one local skip bin operator who services your area, and they quote, supply the skip and set the hire terms.
